authored.observedEffect: Authenticated scratch emits PURE_C, 432 bytes/108 instructions, the retail 32-byte frame, five register-field differences and one opcode difference after symbolic alignment. Temporary canonical link confirms sole C ownership and reduces the residual to seven linked words/12 bytes. The archive return now uses t0, the list base a3, and the output pointer a0, matching retail. The seven words are three site-index byte/register words at offsets 0xAC/0xB0/0xB4, one commutative archive-base addition at 0xE8, the output-base setup at 0x14C, and two output stores at 0x160/0x174. Candidate has fourteen relocs and no reviewed contract.
authored.remainingFailure: The site-index high/low loads use v1/a0 instead of retail a0/v1; shop_archive + 2*shop_index emits the reverse register operand order at 0xE8; and the generated output pointer remains the list base with +14 store offsets rather than adding 14 once in the branch delay slot. Exact target bytes and complete-wave verification remain absent. Original ASM is production.
